verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair axis for a recruiting platform, so the story applies. However, the evidence shows only one-off API calls, event-triggered webhooks, an MCP server and the Workable Agent. None of these documents a recurring schedule or cron-style job capability. Event triggers and an auto-updating job widget are adjacent features, not scheduled recurring workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
